purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (レセプト) processing system — ORCA (JMA standard receipt software); this component handles the 総括表 (summary table) creation/printing workflow
purpose.summary: ORCGT01 is the T01 screen/batch component of the JMA ORCA medical receipt system responsible for generating and printing the 総括表 (summary/aggregate receipt report). It manages screen transitions, job control, print management, and interfaces with multiple DB subsystems for insurance claim processing. It supports reprint, error file output, and job queue management.

notable_features: MCP-based screen linkage (MCPAREA/SPAAREA/LINKAREA) typical of ORCA middleware
File SELECT with FILE STATUS for error file
SPA (scratchpad area) management across screen transitions
Job management DB (JOBKANRI) and print management DB (PRTKANRI) integration
